import json
R,C=16,19
g=[[5]*C for _ in range(R)]
for r,cols in {0:[0,2,4,6,8,10],6:[5,7],10:[2,4,6,8,10,12],14:[5,7,9,11,13,15]}.items():
    for c in cols:g[r][c]=0
    for a,b in zip(cols,cols[1:]):
        if b==a+2:g[r][a+1]=2
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))
print('dims',len(g),set(map(len,g)))
